title: Baby carriages and parts thereof

review.classification: UNSD 38992 includes baby carriages and parts. The complete manual folded single-seat stroller is a defensible subset. Confirmed 38510 covers dolls’ carriages and 49922 covers invalid carriages.
review.route_and_boundary: Bugaboo documents the complete single-seat folding article and its subassemblies. Natraj documents physical manufacturing and final assembly checks. Combined evidence supports qualitative assembly, with actual supplier/factory configuration and quality criteria required.
review.measurement: Unique first release sets calibrated net mass. Raw quantities remain unnormalised until one division by the measured first-release or original cohort denominator. Later service and packaging do not generate duplicate production.
review.allocation: Direct assignment and subdivision precede determining physical causality and residual common-gate market evidence. Gross physical balance and waste quantities are preserved separately.
review.bilingual_and_identity: English and Chinese carry the same selected construction, first-release and original-cohort bases, allocation sequence and inventory row semantics. Public archived ILCD Mass/kg support is retained; other concrete UUIDs and site quantities remain explicitly unresolved.

sources.role: Complete folding stroller and component evidence; listed weights do not set the method denominator.
Independent manufacturing and inspection source; no demonstrated link to the example stroller factory.

delivery_gate: Full npm run validate is required on the exact integration source.
